### Added

- (agent-platform) [Search from three items, sessions organization filter, hide single-option filters](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3315) by [@Rotfuks](https://github.com/Rotfuks) — The Sessions overview gets an `Organization` filter. Search and filters appear on any Agent Platform list from three items, dropdowns offer type-ahead from three options, and a filter with only one possible choice is hidden.
- (agent-platform) [Place environment and organization together on the new agent form](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3313) by [@Rotfuks](https://github.com/Rotfuks) — On the New agent form, Environment and `Owner` (formerly `Organization`) sit together as plain fields, Owner starting on `Platform`. With nothing to choose, both become information lines under `More options`. Agent pages and the Agents list say `Owner` too.
- (muster) [Enter a connector's client ID and secret in the wizard](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3311) by [@Rotfuks](https://github.com/Rotfuks) — When adding a connector whose people sign in with their own account, the wizard takes the app's client ID and secret: `New Secret` has muster store them in a Kubernetes Secret owned by the connector, `Existing Secret` names one that holds them. No more `kubectl` beforehand.
- (muster, agent-platform) [Show connector logos](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3321) by [@Rotfuks](https://github.com/Rotfuks) — Connectors show their logo on the Connectors list, a connector's page and the agent overview, instead of a letter tile. Needs a muster that reports the connector's icon; until that is rolled out, the letter tile stays.
- (ui-react) [Move FileView to ui-react, and show the helm command and build log in CodeBlock](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3358) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — On the review step of the New agent wizard, the helm command under `Install manually instead` is a copyable command, not a file. A failed toolchain build's log shows under `Log of the failed job`, opens at its end and scrolls inside its box.
- (several plugins) [Tags on agents, skills, connectors and workflows](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3316) by [@Rotfuks](https://github.com/Rotfuks) — Agents, skills, connectors and workflows take tags when created or edited, and Customize filters and searches by them (`Tags`). The Connectors tab is one list now: the `infrastructure` and `agent-platform` tags replace its Your connectors, Infrastructure and Internal sub-tabs. Merged into [#3315](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3315), which brought it to main; editing tags needs an agent-manager and muster that support them.

### Fixed

- (agent-platform) [Give refused raw TCP connections one remedy that no setting can allow](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3357) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — When a session shows a refused raw TCP connection (such as `github.com:22`), the notice no longer suggests asking the platform team or editing the agent. It says `No egress setting can allow it.` and suggests HTTPS where the host offers it.
- (agent-platform) [Tell objects already being removed from new ones after reopening the Delete cluster dialog](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3359) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — Reopened while a cluster is being removed, the Delete cluster dialog lists what is already terminating as `Still being removed`, and offers `Finish removal` only when there is something new to remove.
- (backend) [Load the Postgres search engine only where search runs on Postgres](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3360) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — For operators: a backend on SQLite (the chart's default) no longer loads the Postgres search module, so its warning `Postgres search engine is not supported, skipping registration of search-backend-module-pg` stops reaching Sentry at every start.
- (backend-common) [Ignore the empty TechDocs index warning from the Postgres search engine too](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3361) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — For operators: `Index for techdocs was not replaced: indexer received 0 documents`, logged on almost every TechDocs indexing run with the Postgres search engine, no longer reaches Sentry, like the `was not created` wording before it.
- (gs-node) [Report a Mimir that cannot answer once, with a fixed title, and say when older data is temporarily unavailable](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3371) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — When the metrics store cannot read data older than a few hours, the Usage pages, a deployment's resource usage and a cluster's Gateways tab say `Older data is temporarily unavailable` instead of a generic error. For operators: each failure reaches Sentry once, under a fixed title.
- (muster) [Report Muster connection failures as one Sentry issue per failure, not per installation](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3362) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — For operators: when the portal cannot reach Muster, Sentry groups the failures by kind (`Muster MCP request failed: <reason>`) with the installation in the event's data, instead of one issue per installation, and reports each failed request once.
- (muster) [Hold the connector's Calls line in place with a skeleton while its usage is read](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3356) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — On a connector's Details tab, the `Calls, last 30 days` line holds its place with a placeholder while the figure loads, so the lines below no longer jump. Without a figure it says why, such as `Could not be read`.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/compare/v3.30.0...v3.31.0
